name: How do you choose a contractor for a bathroom addition?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners look for when comparing bathroom addition contractors in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What should homeowners look for when comparing bathroom addition contractors in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: A good bathroom addition contractor should be able to explain the project in stages: design, permitting, rough construction, inspections, and finish work. Compare bids line by line so you can see whether plumbing relocation, waterproofing, ventilation, tile labor, and permit support are included. Experience with Los Angeles-area permitting matters because local review and inspection requirements can affect the schedule. Ask how the contractor handles slab work, hidden damage, change orders, and fixture allowances. A strong contractor should also help you understand realistic layout options rather than promising the lowest price without details. If the quote is unusually simple, it may be leaving out work that becomes costly later. For a bathroom addition, clarity matters more than a single headline number because the project has many moving parts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with bathroom-addition experience, clear permit handling, and detailed scope documentation. The strongest bids explain plumbing, electrical, waterproofing, ventilation, and finish allowances separately. A vague quote is a red flag because bathroom additions can hide expensive surprises once walls and floors are opened.
